title: A critic's findings
description: A critic node's output: every finding it makes, each one finding.schema.json's shape (the $defs copy is that file's, which back-lane.py --selftest holds equal). An empty list is a clean read.

finding.description: A critic's finding on one span of brief.json. Code routes it by span_id and the span's claim IDs; the arbiter reads every finding and writes patches.json.

rule.description: The card test or rubric rule the finding applies, as the critic's card names it.

quote.description: The span's words the finding is about, verbatim.
